rv.q: There's more than enough here to suggest that everyone involved is worth following.
...it’s a powerfully visceral experience in no need of words.
It's difficult to imagine the writing in better hands, here abetted by a creative team that includes the Tony-winning sound designer Paul Arditti returning to the theatrical fold.
Despite some reservations about the script, I found myself still carrying the tension after the show ended – ten minutes in to the walk to Victoria Station I realised I was still holding my breath.
Luckily, the outstanding performances and production make Brace Brace an engaging and thrilling watch.
But in the end Brace Brace is just a work in progress.
